evidence.dom: 『Some of our competitors...have greater...brand recognition, longer operating histories, a dominant or more secure position, broader geographic scope, volume, scale, resources, and market share than we do』→決済は競争的で圧倒的シェアなし=競争<40%相当=50
evidence.irr: 『Competition also may intensify as new competitors emerge, businesses combine or enter into new partnerships, and established companies in other segments』→強固なスイッチングコスト証拠なし・代替容易=50
evidence.rep: PayPalの両面ネットワーク(大規模口座+加盟店網)は一定の複製困難性。ただしApple/Adyen/Stripe等の資本力ある既存企業が決済網を構築済で『market share than we do』=困難だが追随可=60
evidence.dur: 決済の両面ネットワーク効果が堀の性質(erosionは別項で捕捉)=ネットワーク=85
evidence.moatdecay: 『competition also may intensify』+『market share than we do』+Braintree『we experienced lower volume and transaction revenue from our Braintree offerings in the first half of 2025』→branded checkout競争圧+Braintreeコモディティ化=yes
evidence.erosion: Braintree『lower volume and transaction revenue from our Braintree offerings in the first half of 2025 followed by revenue and TPV growth in the second half』(利益優先の値付け・低マージン化)+『competition also may intensify』=active(ただしBraintree減はProfitable growth戦略の一部でもある旨注記)
evidence.disrupt: 『Competition also may intensify as new competitors emerge...established companies in other segments』→新規参入で決済地図流動的だが特定の破壊技術ヒットなし=unsettled
evidence.expiry: 限セクション ヒットなし。コンセッション/特許束依存型の期限独占に非該当=no
evidence.geopol: 『In 2025 and 2024, we generated approximately 43% of our net revenues from customers domiciled outside of the U.S.』+『No single country...more than 10% of total net revenues』(地理分散)+『workforce reduction to ensure compliance with a new regulation impacting operations in an international market』(1Q2025・単一規制影響)=中=1
